name: lancam
description: LANCam — Local Network Camera. Turn your smartphone into a low-latency camera for OBS Studio over LAN.
author: Filipe dos Santos

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/desktop
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run package:linux --workspace=apps/desktop
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run package:win --workspace=apps/desktop
scripts.package:all: npm run package:linux && npm run package:win && npm run package:android
